The '''''Regnant''''' was a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] in the service of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]].

==History==
[[File:The_Voidwolf.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Grand Admiral [[Harridax Kirill]], commander of the ''Regnant'']]
The ''Regnant'' was the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Harridax Kirill]], a former [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] turned [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] officer, and commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sirinek]]. The Grand Admiral, more commonly known as "the Voidwolf", commanded a [[Voidwolf's personal strike fleet|sizeable fleet]] of pirate vessels and Imperial privateers.<ref name="Final Score" />

During the [[Battle of Corellia]], the Voidwolf and his fleet prepared to attack [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] shipyards, but was confronted by an [[Voidhound|enterprising smuggler]] and Republic privateer who had been conned into doing the Voidwolf's dirty work for him. Engaging the Voidwolf in battle, the smuggler defeated him on the bridge of the ''Regnant''; the Voidwolf was subsequently [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the grenade he had thrown at his opponent was casually tossed back at him. A failsafe activated with the Voidwolf's death, setting the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to self-destruct, but the smuggler was able to reach the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] in time and returned to Corellia as the ship exploded.<ref name="Final Score" />
